skills.name: localcut-asset-clips
skills.description: Create and edit source clips inside LocalCut assets, with a source range, preview, context and transcript for each clip.

skills.name: localcut-audio-editing
skills.description: Restore and mix dialogue, music and effects in LocalCut using reversible clip processing, shared timing and honest listening evidence.

skills.name: localcut-captions
skills.description: Transcribe local project audio, normalize STT sound-alike errors with an agent LLM pass, and create or revise source-linked LocalCut captions without inventing speech.

skills.name: localcut-export-review
skills.description: Review and deliver the actual LocalCut export, preserving revision identity, technical versus visual and listening evidence, backups and job cleanup.

skills.name: localcut-image-preparation
skills.description: Select and prepare still images or food/product shots for LocalCut while preserving originals, truthful details, composition and explicit generation boundaries.

skills.name: localcut-indexing
skills.description: Use when asked to index an asset/video or import and index media in LocalCut. Populate evidence-grounded Context and normalized original-language source-timed Transcript, preserve human text, and verify saved content after reload; analyze alone is incomplete.

skills.name: localcut-motion-design
skills.description: Create purposeful LocalCut clip and text animation with canonical keyframes, compositing, masks and review at actual timeline times.

skills.name: localcut-music
skills.description: Compose or arrange original music and timed sound cues for LocalCut, using its isolated JavaScript workspace or imported audio with one shared edit clock.

skills.name: localcut-narration
skills.description: Prepare, import and time voiceover takes in LocalCut while preserving scripts, pronunciation, measured duration and generation capability limits.

skills.name: localcut-reference-analysis
skills.description: Study supplied video, audio or image references and translate observed pacing, framing, type and sound into an original LocalCut edit.

skills.name: localcut-start
skills.description: Use this skill when starting an agent-led LocalCut project or choosing its browser. Prefer the built-in browser, route import-and-index requests to localcut-indexing, discover editing workflows and use correct revisions, imports and job lifetimes.

skills.name: localcut-storyboards
skills.description: Plan visual beats, arrange a LocalCut storyboard and export reusable PNG, SVG or editable scene artwork through the shared project.

skills.name: localcut-typography
skills.description: Choose bundled LocalCut fonts and design legible titles, captions and kinetic text for the actual language, canvas and delivery size.

skills.name: localcut-video-editing
skills.description: Assemble or revise footage, images and sound into a coherent LocalCut timeline, with source inspection, continuity, timing and final review.
